description: Radar headlines of the last 24 h against the 29 days before: words in at least 3 headlines today whose share is at least 3x their own usual share (add-half smoothing), their rank today and usually, neighbours today vs usually (new_word / new_company / usual_company), climbing words grouped into stories, and the background words that lead both today and usually. Verdict agenda_shifting / agenda_steady / collecting (from 7 days of history). Counts words only; headlines are third-party text. No AI. Crystal Library bridge: George K. Zipf + John R. Firth + H. P. Luhn + S. C. Bradford.
name: get_zipf
title: Words that climbed their own rank: which words in today's Orb Studio radar headlines rose far above their usual share, and do they keep new company
